<!-- docs-drift-check -->
### 📓 Docs Drift Check
Nothing in this diff resolved to a documentable surface (no symbol, route or SDK anchor derived from **1** changed package(s)), so **this run has no opinion** about the docs.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **1** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **2** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json ba5c754de6e79e62bef45cf7195c279b915730d6` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `a00df3047558fb9f740574badd992320ee7cb20b`
Review-basis: the earlier head `0bd149117a4f4cfd65467dd9a4f78ce396373492` was reviewed in full; this head is one commit on top of it (`a00df30475`, `test(runtime): read leave_organization's variant leg with its bucket-C override set aside`), reviewed as a delta — the diff between the two heads is exactly `packages/runtime/src/action-execution-destructive.test.ts` (+6, no other file).
Local-runs: none
Scope: docs/adr/0011-actions-as-ai-tools.md + packages/platform-objects/src/identity/*.object.ts (12), packages/platform-objects/src/identity/action-confirm-one-dialog.test.ts, packages/runtime/src/action-execution-destructive.test.ts, packages/qa/dogfood/test/mcp-system-object-action-exposure.dogfood.test.ts, packages/runtime/src/action-execution.ts (cited: `systemObjectActionExposureError`, `actionAiExposureError`, `actionConfirmationRefusal`, `actionLooksDestructive`, `isIdentityRouteTarget`), packages/runtime/src/http-dispatcher.ts (cited: `acceptOAuthAccessToken`), docs/adr/0066-unified-authorization-model.md (D4 2026-10-30 note), content/docs/ai/connect-mcp.mdx, .changeset/27900-identity-actions-ai-exposure.md

### ① Derived judgments

- **Bucket fidelity (scripted):** parsed the card's three NAME LISTS (H 20 / C 17 / E 21 = 58, no cross-bucket duplicate) and brace-parsed the 12 identity object files at head (59 named actions). Result: every E action has `ai: { exposed: true, description }` and no `requiresConfirmation` key; every C action has `exposed: true`, `description`, `requiresConfirmation: true`; every H action has no `ai` block; no extra `ai` keys anywhere. 38 `ai` blocks. Mismatches by object.action: **none**. The one action outside the card, `sys_invitation.copy_invitation_link` (type `script`, added by #27843), carries no `ai` block, as the seat ruled.
- **Descriptions:** all 38 measured 92–267 chars (≥40). Each names what the action does, the params the model must pass (e.g. `client_id`, `providerId`, `managerId`, `teamId`/`userId`), and when to call it; every C description ends "Ask the human to confirm before calling", which is model-facing instruction, not the dialog question — the dialog test now asserts `ai.description !== description` for the 13 #7309 sites. Spot-checked wording against the actions' targets/params: no misdescription found. The two `enable_two_factor` descriptions say the param is the current password and that backup codes are answered — accurate, and that is the open question the PR flags to the maintainer (not ruled here). Nothing leaks a secret value; `request_domain_verification` names the DNS TXT record as the answer (its result view already does).
- **Rewritten tests, loosened only as far as needed?**
  - `action-execution-destructive.test.ts` (at `a00df30475`: the only file the delta commit touches, +6 lines in the `leave_organization` sibling case — see ④): the 13-site describe now splits 7 exposed (ban_user, enable/disable/delete_oauth_application, unlink_account, delete_sso_provider, remove_team_member — all E/C per the lists) from 6 human-only (delete_my_account, disable_two_factor ×2, generate_backup_codes, rotate_client_secret, regenerate_backup_codes — all H). The six keep BOTH exclusion pins (gate 1 `systemObjectActionExposureError`, gate 3 `actionAiExposureError`) verbatim; gate 2 still runs on all 13; the seven get a new admitted-at-1-and-3 pin plus `summarizeAction().requiresConfirmation === declared flag`. The "5 flipped" describe moves `disable_oauth_application` out of the heuristic-only set (it now declares `requiresConfirmation: true`) and adds a case pinning that the declared override wins — consistent with `actionLooksDestructive` (override read first). No pin for an unchanged action was dropped.
  - `action-confirm-one-dialog.test.ts`: only the `ai.description` assertion changed (undefined → "truthy dialog `description`, and `ai.description` is not it"). Intent preserved for all 13; nothing else in the file changed.
- **Automatic check over the table:** none. The dogfood's `beforeAll` premise reads one action per bucket (`ban_user` C, `update_my_profile` E, `impersonate_user` H) to drive its cases and says it is not a pin over the table; the destructive test's six-H exclusion pins pre-existed (#7309/#27681). No new key, gate, script, schema or CI step; no runtime/spec/plugin source touched (file list: changeset, mdx, ADR, 12 objects, 3 tests).
- **ADR-0011 addendum:** heading `## Addendum (2026-10-30): …` matches the repo's dated-note convention (ADR-0018/0048 style); placed after Decision, before References. Counts (58 / 38; H 20, C 17, E 21) and all three name lists match the card's name lists exactly; the header-count correction is stated; the H rule is verbatim in spirit ("no `ai.exposed` … without a maintainer ruling that names the action"); `copy_invitation_link` recorded as not assessed; the struck automatic check is recorded with the maintainer's words; the ADR-0066 D4 2026-10-30 note and the three runtime symbols it cites exist on `origin/main`; "37 to `/api/v1/auth/`, 1 (`revoke_api_key`) to the REST data route" verified by target tally; the #28178 dependency is stated as an open decision, not pre-empted.
- **Dogfood:** the agent token is minted by the embedded authorization server (DCR → authorize with `resource` = MCP URL + PKCE S256 → consent → token) — a real OAuth agent, not a session bearer relabelled. The E run pins today's 401 and the session contrast; the C case pins 428 unconfirmed then 401 confirmed with nobody banned; H absent and refused by name. The #27681 session pins (listing attestation, 428, ADR-0126 switch 409, member refused, confirmed ban) are kept; the control moved from `unban_user` (now C) to `impersonate_user` (H). No change to which credentials an identity route or the REST face accepts: no auth/runtime source in the diff.

### ② Semver level

`patch` on `@objectstack/platform-objects` (published, 18.2.0). Clause-②: **no** — no export, key, status, error code or door code added; values written on the existing `ai` key of platform-owned metadata. Metadata-protocol: **none** — nothing an author can newly write, nothing refused, no meaning or default changed. Per Post-Task §3, `none` takes `patch`; the changeset carries both declaration lines line-initial and matches the PR body. Tests and docs publish nothing.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Tier H (`docs/adr/**`): an authorised GOVERNED_APPROVER approval follows this record; no seat lands it.
- Not ruled here, carried to the maintainer by the seat: (a) the two `enable_two_factor` rows in E take the current password and answer new sign-in factors (close to the H test); (b) `copy_invitation_link`'s bucket (answers a bearer URL); (c) `sys_approval_request` (plugin-approvals) declares actions with no `ai` block — the card's premise 2 was already false; not in this PR's surface.
- The E run's ruled outcome waits on #28178; the two "today" expectations in the dogfood are the ones to flip then.
- CI on the head was still in progress at review time (Test Core shards, Type Check); the record judges the diff, not the checks — the queue guard reads the checks.

### ④ Design judgment

- The addendum holds against its first consumer (the 38 declarations in the same diff) and against the mechanism it cites (ADR-0066 D4 note; `systemObjectActionExposureError` per action, gates unchanged). Its claim that an OAuth agent's forward is answered 401 at every one of the 38 targets is measured by the dogfood for the better-auth routes only; for the one REST-data target (`sys_api_key.revoke_api_key` → `PATCH /api/v1/data/sys_api_key/{id}`) it is derived from `http-dispatcher.ts` (`acceptOAuthAccessToken` is true only on `/mcp` paths, so the forwarded OAuth bearer is refused there too), not measured. Accurate as written; the PR body cannot be edited, so this record carries the distinction.
- Resolved at `a00df30475` (was a should-fix at `0bd14911`): the sibling case "`leave_organization` → destructive off variant alone" now asserts `action.ai?.requiresConfirmation === true` on its own and classifies `{ ...action, ai: undefined }` as destructive, which exercises the `mode`/`variant` leg of `actionLooksDestructive` (the override is read first only when `ai.requiresConfirmation !== undefined`); the full declaration is still asserted destructive after it. Ablating the variant would turn the case red, as the thread reports. The guard is honest; no other line changed.
- Note only: in the dialog test, the six H actions' former "no `ai.description`" pin now passes vacuously; the generic assertion covers the intent, so no table pin is being asked for.

Implemented-by: `claude/project-thread-qkb7g0`
Reviewed-by: `session_016WV4czuTWNgKR22fKv7jia (seat subagent)`

**VERDICT: PASS**

## Seat record · PR #28270 · head `a00df3047558fb9f740574badd992320ee7cb20b` · 2026-10-30T23:04Z

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么：** 按裁决 A+（6523087116），12 个身份对象上 58 个具名动作分三档写声明：E 档 21 个写 `ai: { exposed: true, description }`；C 档 17 个另加 `requiresConfirmation: true`（MCP 不带确认即 428，什么都不执行）；H 档 20 个不写 `ai` 块（不在列表里，按名拒绝）。ADR-0011 新增 2026-10-30 附记，列全三档名单与 H 档规则。没有新增任何自动检查、新键或门禁。
- **为什么改：** 执行您对「系统内核对象统一评估」的裁决：允许放开的动作把声明加上，一次到位，不再逐卡。
- **风险与回滚：** 只写既有键的值（`Clause-②: no`，`Metadata-protocol: none`）。计数按卡里列的名字为准（H 20 / C 17 / E 21，38 个 `ai` 块；卡的档头写 19/17/22，已在 ADR 附记更正）。`sys_invitation.copy_invitation_link` 是评估之后才加的，保持不声明、标「未评估」。今天 OAuth agent 能看到 E/C 动作，但执行到身份路由会 401、不改任何东西，真正跑通要等 #28178 的裁决，本 PR 不碰凭据边界。回滚即还原 12 个对象文件的 `ai` 块与 ADR 附记。
- **先看：** `docs/adr/0011-actions-as-ai-tools.md` 的 2026-10-30 附记（三档名单），再看 `sys-user.object.ts` 里各档各一例。
- **两分钟验证：** 跑 `mcp-system-object-action-exposure.dogfood.test.ts`（真实 OAuth agent：E 列出、C 未确认 428、H 不在列表且按名拒绝）。
- **需要你做的：** Tier H（`docs/adr/**`）：请 os-zhuang 或 hotlong 审批（APPROVED）。契约复核 PASS 6535057166，`Head-sha` `a00df3047558fb9f740574badd992320ee7cb20b`。另有三个不阻塞本 PR 的问题已提给您：`enable_two_factor` 两行（要密码、返回登录因子）是否移到 H；`copy_invitation_link` 归哪档；`sys_approval_request` 的 9 个动作是否另卡评估。

**席位意见：** 按裁决原样落地，偏差（计数以名单为准、新增动作不声明）都向保守一侧，且都写进了 ADR 附记。建议批准。

## 席位核对

- **Shape:** draft → main, `Fixes #27900`, `Ruling-ref: 6523087116`. 18 files (+669/−78): 12 identity object files (`ai` blocks only), the ADR-0011 addendum, `content/docs/ai/connect-mcp.mdx` (one bullet), the #27681 MCP dogfood rewritten for an OAuth agent, two existing tests whose premise was "no platform identity action declares `ai`" (`action-execution-destructive.test.ts`, `action-confirm-one-dialog.test.ts`), one changeset. `check-governed-merges --pr 28270`: **GOVERNED** (`docs/adr/**`), landing tier H.
- **Premise:** blocker #27681 closed (PR #27940); the thread re-read all 58 actions on `main` and stopped on drift (the 59th action; the header counts). The seat chose the conservative path within the ruling; both questions are with the maintainer and the ADR note records them.
- **File surface:** within the claim as amended (6533801624).
- **Declarations:** `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none` (values on an existing key, platform-owned metadata); `@objectstack/platform-objects` `patch`.
- **Contract review:** `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`, **PASS** at this head, 6535057166 (full review at `0bd14911`, delta at `a00df304`). Bucket fidelity was checked by script against the card's name lists: zero mismatches. Carried note: the OAuth 401 at `revoke_api_key`'s REST data target is derived from the dispatcher, not measured (the other 37 targets are measured).
- **Out of scope, with the maintainer:** `enable_two_factor` bucket, `copy_invitation_link` bucket, `sys_approval_request`'s 9 unassessed actions.
- **Local (card thread):** build 115/115; 94 derived gate families exit 0, 0 NOT-MEASURED; `pnpm lint` 0; the dogfood ablation turned 8/11 cases red. Report 6534850317.
- **Gate check-runs on this head:** 50 total, 38 success, 12 skipped by the path filter, 0 failed. `mergeable_state: clean`.
- **Landing:** Tier H. Waiting for an authorised APPROVED review (GOVERNED_APPROVERS). After the approval, the seat lands it: ready, then auto-merge. The PR is not flipped ready before that.
